## OpenAI GPT OSS 120B E2EE API

OpenAI GPT OSS 120B E2EE is a large language model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `e2ee-gpt-oss-120b-p`. It is end-to-end encrypted. It is also available without end-to-end encryption, as [OpenAI GPT OSS 120B](/models/openai-gpt-oss-120b).

GPT OSS 120B running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). OpenAI's open-weight 117B-parameter MoE model with configurable reasoning depth and native tool use, with hardware attestation evidence available for independent verification.

### OpenAI GPT OSS 120B E2EE API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `e2ee-gpt-oss-120b-p` | E2EE | E2EE | $0.13 / $0.65 per 1M |

### OpenAI GPT OSS 120B E2EE specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | OpenAI |
| Released | Mar 18, 2026 |
| Privacy | E2EE |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| License | Apache 2.0 |
| Context window | 128K tokens |
| Max output | 32K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | low, medium, high |

### How to use the OpenAI GPT OSS 120B E2EE API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "e2ee-gpt-oss-120b-p"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "e2ee-gpt-oss-120b-p",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "low"
  }'
```
